findings.title: API tokens never expire
findings.description: REST framework tokens are issued without an expiry and are not rotated on password change, so a leaked token grants indefinite access to payment data.

findings.cweName: Information Exposure Through an Error Message
findings.title: DEBUG enabled on internet-facing staging
findings.description: Staging runs with DEBUG=True and is reachable from the internet. Error pages show full tracebacks, settings values and the SQL behind payment endpoints.

findings.title: Invoice PDFs downloadable across organizations
findings.description: The invoice PDF view looks invoices up by id without filtering on the requesting user's organization. Any customer can download another company's invoices by iterating ids.

findings.title: Payment memo text written unescaped into audit logs
findings.description: Payment memo text is written into audit log lines without escaping newlines, so a customer can forge additional audit entries.

findings.cweName: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
findings.title: Ledger report has no page size limit
findings.description: The ledger report endpoint accepts any page_size and loads the full result into memory. A single request for a large organization can exhaust worker memory.

findings.title: Weak password policy for finance users
findings.description: AUTH_PASSWORD_VALIDATORS only enforces a minimum length of 6 characters and has no common-password check.
